    COALESCE(g.certainty, 'unavailable'::text) AS grade_status,

   FROM ((exam_subjects es
     LEFT JOIN answer_key_versions k ON (((k.exam_subject_id = es.id) AND k.is_current AND (k.status = 'published'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN grade_cutoff_versions g ON (((g.exam_subject_id = k.exam_subject_id) AND (g.paper_variant = k.paper_variant) AND (g.max_score = k.max_score) AND g.is_current AND (g.status = 'published'::text))));
